title: 2025: the fine-structure constant is fixed by the continuum with no free parameter

statements.text: The fine-structure constant $\alpha$ is fixed by the ratio of the vacuum impedance of the continuum to the circulation quantum of the flow, with no free parameters once the background satisfies continuity.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: I show that the fine structure constant is fixed by the ratio of the vacuum impedance of the continuum and the circulation quantum of the flow.
